metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Becoming Led Zeppelin
metas.description: The film traces the journeys of the four members of the Stairway To Heaven rockers through the music scene of the 1960s and their meeting in the summer of 1968, culminating in 1970.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Avicii - I'm Tim
metas.description: This is the story of Tim Bergling, a shy and insecure boy who, without realizing it, suddenly created one of the world's most loved artists - Avicii.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · I Am: Celine Dion
metas.description: A raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar's struggle with Stiff Person Syndrome, a life-altering illness.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Jung Kook: I Am Still
metas.description: Jung Kook invites viewers on a journey showcasing his rise to stardom, creative process, work ethic, and challenges as a global icon, with unseen footage, interviews, and electrifying performances.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Epic: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · The Alabama Solution
metas.description: Incarcerated men defy the odds to expose a cover-up in one of America's deadliest prison systems.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Music by John Williams
metas.description: Follows the life of legendary composer John Williams.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · The Last Journey
metas.description: Renowned Swedish TV-duo Filip and Fredrik embark on a trip to France, aiming to rekindle the zest for life of Filip's father

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · MST - Terra Prometida
metas.description: Filmed across Brazil, the documentary features testimonials from former "Sem Terra" movement members, experts, farmers and local leaders.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · Ocean with David Attenborough
metas.description: Attenborough explores the planet's undersea habitats, revealing the greatest age of ocean discovery and emphasizing the ocean's vital importance while exposing its problems and highlighting opportunities for marine life recovery.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · My Mom Jayne
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of Mariska Hargitay's mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield, who died tragically in a car accident at age 34 when Mariska was only three years old.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Naza
metas.description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · 2000 Meters to Andriivka
metas.description: Amid the failing counteroffensive, a journalist follows a Ukrainian platoon on their mission to traverse one mile of heavily fortified forest and liberate a strategic village from Russian occupation. But the farther they advance through their destroyed homeland, the more they realize that this war may never end.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Queen of Chess
metas.description: Hungarian chess prodigy Judit Polgár challenges champion Garry Kasparov and her controlling father over 15 years, breaking gender barriers to become the greatest female player ever and one of history's finest.
